row.notes: Runs only when entrant_key[0]==1 and custom_key[0]==1 and Wear_Get_DriverCustomisation_Thunk(*(self+0x28), custom_key) returns a record. Resolves a team slot id via 0x14246f660; if the id is 0x3fff it builds a fresh team customisation and calls Ent_EntrantsSystem_AddTeamCustomisation, otherwise it finds the existing team record (id at +0x100/+0x102), copies its 128-char name block (+0x78..+0xf0) and calls Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceTeam_2. In both paths the two colour/decal blocks come from the customisation record at +0x48..+0x64 and +0x78..+0x94.
